method.ritualSteps: devmap <map>; wait 12000; skipcinematic; wait 4000; r_ambientScale; then screenshotPNG at the default and at 0, 4, 0, 4, 0.6, 0.5, 0.6, 0.5, 1.7 s apart (.tmp/ritual-ambient-scale/steps-ab.cfg)
method.gridMask: luma up by more than 24 from 0 to 4 in both pairs, the 0.6 capture between them, each pair of equal settings within 4; Alice: outer 40 columns (HUD) left out (.tmp/ritual-ambient-scale/measure.py)
method.vulkanRtx: measured on the GL run mask of the same map and build, bloom hazing their own 0-against-4 pair (measure_on_mask.py)
method.buildComparison: first capture (each build at its default) of the two builds, on the before GL mask (build_compare.py)
method.retailComparison: retail fakk2.exe 1.02 capture of the same spawn from the earlier sweep, aligned by gradient correlation within 40 px (retail_compare.py)
method.ql: devmap campgrounds ffa; team f; cg_thirdPerson 1; captures at the default and at 0.6, 10, 0.6, 10, 1; then 150 and 0.5 printed (ql_probe.py measure); map campgrounds ffa without cheats: set 25, cvarlist, quit, configs read back (ql_probe.py option); web interface: web_changeHash #/settings/video, web_status, web_dumpSurface (ql_webui_probe.py)
